verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is SDK- and CLI-first. Programmatic APIs cover LLM generation, streaming, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT, TTS, VAD, voice agents, VLM, image generation and model downloads. The cloud adds an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and account identity and usage are available from the CLI. However, Cloud authentication is a browser-only approval flow with no documented key-based or headless alternative, and no OpenAPI spec could be found to confirm parity. Missing for 10: a non-browser/programmatic auth path, a published OpenAPI or full API reference demonstrating UI-to-API parity, documentation of any dashboard features and their API equivalents, and independent corroboration.
